The resurrection of Jesus Christ is celebrated on Sunday during Holy Week.
Many people are celebrating Passover this week.
Good Friday commemorates the death of Jesus Christ.
The events of Holy Week lead up to the central Christian celebration of Easter.
Passover began earlier this week.
God will look after everyone regardless of their beliefs.
We can overcome challenges if we work together.
America has previously endured difficult times and emerged stronger.

assumptions.text: The speaker believes that religious observance fosters communal unity.
Collective resilience depends on shared faith and mutual support.
Spiritual reflection during Holy Week enhances personal and societal strength.
The audience includes diverse believers and non-believers alike.
Public expressions of goodwill strengthen national cohesion.
The speaker views themselves as having moral authority to speak on collective well-being.
Hope and encouragement are effective tools for motivating group action.
Cultural continuity through tradition reinforces community identity.
The phrase 'great American spirit' carries positive connotations tied to perseverance.
Audience members value being acknowledged and included in shared narratives.
